prompts.background: Use case photorealistic-natural. ONE high-resolution photographic landscape, wide 3:2 canvas matching a 1920x1248 desktop scene composition. Calm first-person human eye level, fixed natural 35mm lens, level horizon. Soft natural illumination, realistic texture, moderate contrast and saturation, no HDR, no fantasy glow. A continuous believable space with a clearly visible route from bottom center toward a stopping place near x=50%, y=48%. This is a BACKGROUND PLATE for later multi-plane FFmpeg camera parallax: keep the central view open, do not include large close framing objects at the edges since these are separate layers. The image must fill every edge with scenery. No people, bodies, animals, signs, buildings, text, logos, watermarks, collage or panels. A quiet NATURAL FLOWER GARDEN in morning diffuse light from upper LEFT, soft cream and pale pink blossoms, sage green foliage, organically curved narrow earth/gravel path from bottom center into a welcoming small open space framed by flowering shrubs. A clear center corridor, recognizable cultivated flower borders different from wild prairie; no formal palace, buildings, benches, fountains, sculptures, signs, people or bees. Close flower stalks at outer corners will be added separately, so keep near frame edges relatively open.
prompts.middle: Use case photorealistic-natural compositing. Reference image 1 is ONLY the lighting, texture, palette and eye-level perspective reference. Generate ONE independent middle-near parallax layer on a genuinely TRANSPARENT RGBA background. Full wide 3:2 landscape canvas aligned with reference. Draw ONLY two flower-border clusters of pale pink and cream small blossoms and sage-green foliage at the lower outer LEFT 18% and outer RIGHT 18% of canvas. Photographic delicate natural stems grow from beyond bottom edge; reach up only into lower 40%, not central view. The center and all upper half transparent. Match the reference with soft sunlight from upper LEFT, natural material detail and moderate contrast. Preserve CENTRAL 60% of width as completely transparent from top to bottom for an open pathway. No backdrop, no ground plane, no solid-color background, no fake checkerboard, no vignette; every pixel except actual objects is transparent. No people, animals, text, logo, watermark or collage. One cutout plate ready to composite over the reference, not a rendering of a finished combined scene.
prompts.near: Use case photorealistic-natural compositing. Reference image 1 is ONLY a lighting, color and photographic texture reference. Generate ONE closest foreground layer with actual RGBA alpha transparency, wide 3:2 full canvas. Draw ONLY a few close softly out-of-focus sage-green leaves and small pale pink flower stems emerging from beyond the bottom outer corners. Only bottom 22% and outer 17% each side, softly photographed, no artificial blur background. Lighting matches reference: warm soft morning light from upper LEFT and natural gentle shadows. Everything above the lower corner foliage and the central 60% corridor must be completely transparent, not a blurry backdrop. Fine natural edges, no ground plane, no filled background, no solid color, no painted checkerboard, no vignette, no whole scene, no collage. No person, animal, text or watermark. Match the realism of the reference and keep the near plants modest so that they will slide outward as the viewpoint moves forward.
